svg.text: Drivetrain configuration – shaft, gearbox, alternator and switching
Drivetrain – One Shaft Line, Catalogue Parts, 100 kW to 2 MW
INDICATIVE ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION – NOT TO SCALE
Dimensions to be confirmed by survey and detailed design
SEALED POD ENVELOPE 2 000 × 1 000 × 1 500 – lifts out as one piece
– All six sizes share the shaft, seal, gearbox and alternator families; only the ratings change with capacity.
– Gearbox and alternator are catalogue genset items (NORD, SEW, WEG, Leroy-Somer class); AFE adds the pod, blades and legs.
– Pod lifts out on four eyes for service; a spare pod goes straight back in.
– Switching, protection relays and telemetry sit in the switchgear shed ashore.
